title: शब्दार्थसम्बन्धानामनुशीलनम्
nepali: प्रस्तुतोऽयं लेखो दर्शनपक्षाऽभिमतवैयाकरणराद्घान्ते सुप्रसिद्घशब्दार्थसम्बन्धानुशीलने नित्यत्वाऽनित्यत्वे च केन्द्रितोऽस्ति ।वस्तुतः प्रस्तावितविषये शब्दस्य व्युत्पत्तिपूर्वकं नित्यत्वानित्यत्वविचारप्रसङ्गे शब्दतत्वमर्थतत्वं तयोः सम्बन्धञ्चा–श्रित्यानुसङ्गिकध्वनिविषये च परिचर्चा विहिता वर्तते । अपारे संसारसागरे जायमानेषु चतुरशीतिलक्ष्यविधेषु जीवेषुमानवमात्राणां व्यवहारकारणीभूर्तोयं शब्दो व्यावहारिकः पारमार्थिकश्च द्विविधोऽपि वैयाकरणातिरिक्तनैयायिकवैशेषिकमीमां–सकालङ्कारिकादितत्तदाचार्याणांञ्चापरिहारिकोऽनुसन्धेयो ज्ञेयश्च, अत एव कः शब्दः ? कोऽर्थः ? तयोः सम्बन्धश्च कीदृशः ?तेषां नित्यत्वं कार्यत्वञ्च तŒवं किमिति स्वाभाविकीं समेषां हृदि जायमानां जिज्ञासामनेनैवानुसन्धानेन परिहर्तुं प्रयते ।
american_english: This presented article is focused on examining the celebrated relation between word and meaning and on their eternity and non-eternity within the grammarians' doctrine favored by philosophical perspectives. In fact, regarding the proposed subject, in the context of considering eternity and non-eternity alongside the etymological derivation of the word, a discussion is conducted concerning the principle of word, the principle of meaning, their relationship, and the incidental topic of sound. In the boundless ocean of worldly existence, among the 8.4 million species of living beings that come into being, this word—which constitutes the instrument of worldly conduct for human beings alone—is twofold, both empirical and ultimate, and is indispensable, worthy of investigation, and essential to be understood by the respective preceptors such as the Naiyayikas, Vaisheshikas, Mimamsakas, and rhetoricians in addition to the grammarians; hence, what is a word? What is meaning? And of what nature is their relationship? "What is the truth regarding their eternity and createdness?"—it is attempted through this very research to resolve this natural curiosity arising in the hearts of all.
